{{Quote|A degree-six revolt, population equivalent to the Duros uprising on Zilior. Subjects occupy a moderate radius of jungle. Good, good&hellip;|Lord Drowl, comparing the revolt to one on Dromund Kaas|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Occurring at some point prior to or during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the '''Duros uprising on Zilior''' was a rebellion comprising members of the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Species/Legends|species]], who were revolting against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on<ref name="TOR" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zilior]].<ref name="Zilior">While {{TORcite|type=general|Testing Grounds|Dromund Kaas}} does not state that [[Zilior]] was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]], it was previously established to be one in ''[[Jedi Quest: The Moment of Truth]]''.</ref>

Around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire, [[Drowl]], a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] affiliated with the Empire, was familiar with the population size of the Duros uprising on Zilior. While working on suppressing a [[Degree-six revolt|degree-six]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Dromund Kaas rebellion|rebellion]] in the jungle outside of [[Kaas City]] on the Empire's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], Drowl noted that the two revolts had equivalent populations.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Duros uprising on Zilior is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] produced by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]]. The event is briefly spoken of in a comparison made by Lord Drowl at the start of the quest "Testing Grounds," which is available to [[Hunter (individual)|all]] [[Cipher Nine|four]] [[Darth Nox|Imperial]] [[Empire's Wrath|classes]] on Dromund Kaas, the second planet for Imperial players in the game. Although the uprising on Zilior is mentioned by the Sith Lord, it is not made clear exactly when it occurred or what the outcome was. Additionally, while Drowl states that the Empire frequently assigned [[Gender/Legends|him]] to put an end to rebellions on Imperial planets, the game does not make it clear whether Drowl was involved with the uprising on Zilior.<ref name="TOR" />
